Bank main and service footprints are cut from Hoghton ground and the two coarse neighbouring placeholder volumes, which remain present. Existing elevation controls agree at sampled seam points.
lod_policy: Walk retains structure, apertures, sashes and gate; it omits small cornice brackets. District is a fixed independently authored envelope with rounded corner, recessed banking frontage, roof, service strip and raised rear bay; appearance projects to a shared 512-pixel atlas.
checks: Master/exterior coplanar selections, upward roof/outward curved corner, finite UV geometry, London Square junction/seam/through-road and Hoghton bank exclusions are checked. Exported levels, mixed LoDs and assembled visual inspection still required.
